_note: epl-agentd on the box. Copy to $EPL_HOME/loop/agentd.json (EPL_HOME defaults to ~/epl) and start it with `run-mcp.sh agentd`. Every arm is a flip-block base config already staged and pinned by sha256 in its own arms[0].source_sha256 (templates in examples/flip/); keys are the only runtime keys a screen may flip on that arm. Add a nighthawk section (see docs/loop.md) only once the Nighthawk fork's nighthawk_service and nighthawk_mcp are staged and pinned. An arm's keys are a list, or {key: {read_point: per_request|per_connection|per_config}}: per_config keys are refused, per_connection keys need flip_extra.cycle_connections (the relay-write guard is read when a connection's file event is built). housekeeping_cpus has no default: set it to CPUs disjoint from the SUT, client and origin CPUs and their SMT siblings; the daemon refuses to start without it. The CPU sets, rates and paths here are the example box's.
